name: Monstrata Fracture
source:
I knew college would be a different experience, but I didn't expect it to be a different world!

I should have known something was up when the main campus burned down and I had to start attending school in a creepy haunted castle. As it turns out, the reputation is deserved - the place is full of monsters nobody else seems to be able to see.

It doesn't take long for them to notice me, either. But... not in the way you'd expect monsters to notice a human in their midst. 

What do I do? Let an alkonost take me to tea? Or preserve the stability of the barrier between worlds? Even if the monster world is drawing me in, I can't help but feel like something about it is wrong. Broken. 

And maybe I can fix it...

[From [url=https://astralore.itch.io/monstrata-fracture]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我知道大学生活会有所不同，却没想到会来到另一个世界！

主校区烧毁后，我不得不转去一座阴森的闹鬼城堡上学，那时就该察觉事情不对了。事实证明，那里闹鬼的名声并非浪得虚名——城堡里到处都是其他人似乎看不见的怪物。

没过多久，它们也注意到了我。但……注意我的方式，并不像你想象中怪物看待人类那样。

我该怎么办？接受一只阿尔科诺斯特的茶会邀请？还是维持两界屏障的稳定？即使怪物世界正把我吸引过去，我仍忍不住觉得那里有什么不对劲。有什么东西坏掉了。

也许我能修好它……

[来源：[url=https://astralore.itch.io/monstrata-fracture]itch.io[/url]]
